description: Source code for a paging scheduler component in a 3GPP-compliant wireless communication system, implementing paging logic, resource allocation, and scheduling functions.

classes.name: paging_scheduler
classes.description: Class responsible for managing paging scheduling, resource allocation, and transmission in a cellular network.

methods.name: run_slot
methods.description: Executes scheduling logic for a specific time slot, handling pending paging requests and resource allocation.

methods.name: handle_pending_paging_requests
methods.description: Processes queued paging requests, adding new ones and discarding duplicates or when full.

methods.name: is_paging_opportunity
methods.description: Determines if a given slot is suitable for paging a specific UE based on 3GPP timing and DRX parameters.

methods.name: find_pdsch_time_resource
methods.description: Finds an available PDSCH time resource index for paging transmission if the slot is a paging opportunity.

methods.name: get_accumulated_paging_msg_size
methods.description: Calculates the total size of the paging message for a set of UEs.

methods.name: handle_paging_information
methods.description: Queues new paging information for processing.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the scheduler, clearing pending requests and internal state.

methods.name: has_space_for_pdsch
methods.description: Checks if there is sufficient space in the PDSCH for a paging grant.

methods.name: is_there_space_available_for_paging
methods.description: Verifies if enough resources are available for paging in a given slot and resource index.

methods.name: allocate_paging
methods.description: Allocates resources and constructs paging grants for UEs scheduled in a specific slot.

methods.name: fill_paging_grant
methods.description: Fills in the details of a paging grant, including DCI and PDSCH configuration.
